metric: Queries that every KumoSQL stage (parse, lineage, fingerprint, cleanup, format, self-equivalence, DuckDB execution of each rewrite) handles with a real answer; the rest declined honestly.
correctness: 0 proven rewrites returned different rows in DuckDB on generated tables (3 seeds, values include each query's constants); 0 crashes, 0 timeouts, 0 lost reads; 475/475 clean
coverage_of: Queries that did not pass every stage: of the 475, 121 were declined honestly (unsupported), 0 timed out and 0 errored; the 354 that passed have no outcome column.
held_out: 53/70 (75.7%) on the hash-held-out fifth of this sample, 0 wrong (seen during development; see caveats)
command: python tools/benchmark_corpora.py fetch sqlstorm dsb && python tools/analytical_coverage.py --split all --limit 60
caveats: Our own score, not an official one. Sample of 60 queries from each of 8 corpora (of ~214k); 5 queries sqlglot could not convert from Postgres are excluded. Baseline before the fixes was 243/475 (51.2%); 334/475 when first merged, 354/475 after later prover merges made 20 more TPC-DS cleanup rewrites provable. The held-out split was introduced after this sample was used for development.
performance: about 5 s per query on one core; format_sql (sqlfluff) is about half of it
